summary: Murillo is in the predicted back three at Bournemouth and has no injury news. Domínguez is unlikely to play.

claims.text: Predicted in a back three with Jair Cunha and Milenković; Domínguez unlikely with a muscle injury.

claims.text: Glasner: Domínguez out for weeks after a training setback; Schlager a doubt; Diomande and Sangare assessed after travel disruption. No concern raised about Murillo.
